description: React component for a customizable input field with validation, error handling, and UI features like clear button and tooltips.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: React forwardRef component implementing a customizable input with validation and UI features.

methods.name: validateInput
methods.description: Performs validation on the input value, setting error messages if validation fails.

methods.name: handleOnFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating focus state and calling external onFocus.

methods.name: handleOnBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, validating input and updating focus state.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles change event, clearing custom messages and calling external onChange.

methods.name: handleOnClear
methods.description: Handles clear button click, invoking external onClear.
